_comment: Paste the contents of `permissions.deny` and `hooks` into <angle-root>/.claude/settings.json. Replace ABSOLUTE PATH PLACEHOLDERS with your actual paths. This snippet enforces method #2 (declarative deny) and is the prerequisite for method #3 (hook).
_what_this_protects: Hard-blocks cross-KB and cross-angle reads. Does NOT enforce intra-angle isolation (M1 reading M2) — that stays soft + verified. See SKILL.md 'per-agent granularity limit'.

_replace_placeholders.<REPO_ROOT>: Absolute path to webinar-AI repo root (e.g. /Users/javiquix/Desktop/quixdev/webinar-AI)
_replace_placeholders.<KB_PARENT>: Absolute path to the parent dir of sibling KBs (e.g. /Users/javiquix/Desktop/quixdev/F1)
_replace_placeholders.<ANGLE_NAME>: The current angle folder name (e.g. webinar-angle-C)

_note_on_intra_angle: We deliberately do NOT deny <REPO_ROOT>/<ANGLE_NAME>/modulo-* — each agent is supposed to read its own module. Per-agent path differentiation cannot be expressed in settings.json; the hook (method #3) cannot reliably do it either. Intra-angle isolation is prompt-soft + post-run-verified, by design and by limitation.
_note_on_pattern_syntax: Claude Code accepts `Read(/abs/path/**)` (glob) and `Bash(cmd:/abs/path/**)` (command+pattern). Patterns with spaces or special chars must be in valid glob form. Test by trying to read a denied path from inside the session and confirming the tool call is rejected before subagents launch.
_note_on_data_layout_2026_05_31: <REPO_ROOT>/data/ is now a real directory tree (raw/, sim/segments/, sim-only/segments/) — not symlinks. Agents physically cannot navigate from their data/ view back to KB003. The Read(<KB_PARENT>/KB003/**) deny is still useful as a backstop for any code path that constructs an absolute KB003 path directly (smoke-tested 2026-05-31: declarative deny is parent-only and doesn't propagate to Task subagents; rely on the hook for subagent isolation).
